note: Reference copy. voxxa compiles its binding profiles into the app; churches do not edit them. Keys only: Presenter has no remote-control API and no read-back. Keys are sent only while Presenter's window is in front. Goto inside a song and the step into the next song in Presenter's list are Right/Left presses counted by voxxa (songs open on a blank slide); any other song change is a sentence to the operator.
keys_note: Example keys step, [UNVERIFIED] as a profile step: confirm on the presenter test card (T8) before use. `goto.keys` is the move from the live song's last slide into the next song, only when that song is the next item in Presenter's list (its service_position is one higher, nothing between): Right shows the next song's blank, Right shows its first slide. The founder saw those two key effects on the booth PC (#183, 2026-11-24), and the driver makes this move today with counted Right presses; the same move sent as a keys step has never run, so goto.keys runs only after test card T8 confirms it; until then the driver turns it into a hint (ADR-024 § 5), and voxxa keeps making this move with counted Right presses as it does today. A keys step holds 1 to 4 chords, only from allowed_keys. Never sent: F10, F11, F12 (they clear slide content, media, everything), Up, Down, numpad + and - (they change the service item), '.', Esc, Enter, any Ctrl+Alt+arrow; also F2 and F3 (they create service items) and F6 to F9 (they open Presenter windows), per WorshipTools' keyboard shortcuts page.

blank.unsupported: F10 clears lyrics; the key that brings them back is not confirmed (test card T4).

clear_media.unsupported: F11/F12 clear media; voxxa never sends them
